about: List prices in USD per million tokens, read 2026-11-18, for usage_session_end.py. One row per model ID as the transcript names it; a model not listed costs null, never a guess. cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are 1.25x and 2x input. `above` is the rate for a request whose prompt (input plus cache reads and writes) exceeds prompt_tokens; a rate it leaves out makes that request's cost null.
